project_type: Next.js 16 App Router web app (TypeScript) — PhishSafe, an authorized security-awareness / phishing-simulation training platform. Supabase (PostgreSQL + Auth), Tailwind v4 plus a large semantic-class globals.css, lucide-react icons.
build_system: npm. Next.js 16.0.10 build via `next build`. No bundler quirks beyond standard Next App Router. Tailwind v4 via @tailwindcss/postcss, but the app relies heavily on semantic CSS classes in src/app/globals.css (one large file) rather than utilities in most pages.
test_framework: NONE — there is no test framework in this repo. Do NOT add one.
test_command: npm run lint   (eslint; there are no unit tests — build + lint is the verification gate)
verification_instructions: After each feature run `npm run build` (Next production build = the real type-check/compile gate) and `npm run lint`. There are no automated tests; a feature is verified when build and lint both pass AND a grep/manual check confirms the feature-specific invariant (e.g. no 'Gemini'/'DeepSeek' user-facing strings remain, generated email HTML instruction requires the {{link}} token). Do not start/kill any long-running dev server.
snapshot_or_generated_files: package-lock.json is updated by `npm install` when @google/genai is removed — commit it. No other generated/checked-in artifacts.
environment_constraints: Never read or modify the .env file (real secrets, git-ignored). Keep env var NAMES exactly: DASHSCOPE_API_KEY, DASHSCOPE_BASE_URL, DEEPSEEK_MODEL. Do not modify scripts/seed-default-content.mjs (it holds the canonical safety-framed seed content). Do not add a test framework.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md/CONTRIBUTING.md present. Follow existing code style: route handlers use `const supabase = await createClient(); const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser(); if (!user) return 401`. Client pages use 'use client' + useState. Keep safety posture: do NOT weaken 'SECURITY AWARENESS TRAINING SIMULATION' markers, 'credentials are NOT stored' guarantees, or the sandbox="" preview iframe.
key_patterns: Supabase helper @/lib/supabase/server exports async createClient(). AI lib request shape (MUST preserve): OpenAI-compatible POST to `${baseUrl}/chat/completions` with { model, messages:[{role:system,content:string},{role:user,content:[{type:text,text},{type:image_url,image_url:{url:dataUrl}}]}] }, Authorization: Bearer DASHSCOPE_API_KEY; default base URL https://dashscope-intl.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1, default model deepseek-v4.1-flash. Markdown code fences are stripped from the model output. Email templates use the literal {{link}} placeholder; campaigns/actions.ts replaces /{{link}}/g with the tracking URL — generated emails MUST include {{link}} or the campaign breaks. Template form fields: name, subject, bodyHtml (DB column body_html). Landing form fields: name, urlSlug, htmlContent.
